source_workflow: YouTube Autonomous Growth OS V2.1 — Cloud LLM — Node Lite

execution_strategy.http: httpx with workflow headers/query/body/binary behavior and credential injection
execution_strategy.if_switch: Python routing with the workflow's condition operators
execution_strategy.wait: asyncio sleep; the workflow's only wait is bounded AI repair backoff capped by 30 seconds

local_ui.security: localhost-oriented; credentials are written to local .env and .env is excluded from Git

verification.ci: GitHub Actions workflow committed as optional CI only
verification.live_external_apis: must be verified on the user's Windows machine because secrets and private PostgreSQL are not available to the repository runtime

known_boundary: This is a behavior-preserving n8n-to-Python runtime migration, not a reimplementation of every internal n8n feature. The workflow's observed Code-node globals and node types are covered; unknown node types fail closed.
